name: Blue Rota
cardAlt: Blue Rota police shift and pay app preview
title: Shift, pay & overtime app for UK police
description: Blue Rota helps UK police officers track shifts, leave, pay and overtime, lets their partners see the rota, and gives admins one place to set the Police Federation pay rules.
coverCaption: Officer app, family app and admin

challenge.heading: Making police pay rules readable
paragraphs: Police officers work rotating shifts under detailed Federation rules for overtime, rest days, bank holidays and part-time pay. Most never know what they are owed, and their families can’t plan around the rota.
The rules themselves change: new pay scales each September, new bank holidays and high-demand days every year.
The goal: admins set the rules once, officers see their real numbers, and partners see the schedule.

rows.heading: The rules become the spec
rows.text: I turned the Federation rules into admin screens: pay scales by rank and version, bank holidays and high-demand days with multipliers, leave by years of service, six overtime rule types and part-time pro-rata formulas.
rows.caption: Admin · Pay scale management

rows.heading: Three products, one engine
rows.text: The admin dashboard holds the rules, a calculation layer turns them into hourly rates and multipliers, the officer app shows the results, and Partner Sync links an officer to a partner.
rows.caption: Calendar · shift types and sync days

rows.heading: Your shift, your numbers
rows.text: The Today tab shows a live shift ring with Extend Shift, plus leave, payday and overtime at a glance. Overtime entries move from Pending to Put Through, with the right rate applied.
rows.caption: Overtime tracker

outcome.title: Rules in one place
outcome.text: Admins update pay scales and multipliers once; the apps use them from the effective date.

outcome.title: Overtime made visible
outcome.text: Officers see what each entry earns and what is still pending, and learn the rights they lose money on.

outcome.title: Family in the loop
outcome.text: Partner Sync shows both rotas side by side, with the days you are both free.
